text: The prince was standing in the blue room. <break time="0.8s" /> And his voice rang loudly and clearly. <break time="0.8s" /> Through all seven rooms. <break time="0.8s" /> A few courtiers moved toward the stranger. <break time="0.8s" /> But a strange fear stopped them. <break time="0.8s" /> And no one put out a hand. <break time="0.8s" /> To seize him. <break time="0.8s" /> With slow, solemn steps. <break time="0.8s" /> The figure walked past the prince. <break time="0.8s" /> And through the blue, purple, green. <break time="0.8s" /> Orange, white, and violet rooms. <break time="0.8s" /> Angry and ashamed of his own fear. <break time="0.8s" /> The prince rushed through the six rooms. <break time="0.8s" /> With a dagger. <break time="0.8s" /> But no one followed him. <break time="0.8s" /> When the figure reached. <break time="0.8s" /> The far end of the black room. <break time="0.8s" /> It suddenly turned. <break time="0.8s" /> And faced the prince. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a sharp cry. <break time="0.8s" /> The dagger fell onto the black carpet. <break time="0.8s" /> And a moment later. <break time="0.8s" /> Prince Prospero fell there lifeless. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the guests. <break time="0.8s" /> With the wild courage of despair. <break time="0.8s" /> Rushed into the black room. <break time="0.8s" /> And seized the figure. <break time="0.8s" /> Standing by the ebony clock. <break time="0.8s" /> To their horror. <break time="0.8s" /> They found that there was nothing at all. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside the grave clothes and the mask. <break time="0.8s" /> Now they knew that it was the Red Death itself. <break time="0.8s" /> That had come. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a thief in the night. <break time="0.8s" /> One by one. <break time="0.8s" /> The guests fell in the halls of their party. <break time="0.8s" /> The ebony clock stopped. <break time="0.8s" /> The fires went out. <break time="0.8s" /> And Darkness, Decay, and the Red Death. <break time="0.8s" /> Ruled over all.
